questions.question: A TV is listed at ₹15,000 and a discount of 18% is offered on the list price. What additional discount must be offered to the customer to bring the net price to ₹10,947?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

MP = Rs. 15000

Discount given = 18%

Desired final price = Rs. 10947 

**Concept used:**

SP = MP - MP × Discount%

**Calculation:**

Price after 1st discount = 15000 - 15000 × 18%

⇒ Rs. 12300

Addition discount = (12300-10947)/(12300) × 100% = 11%

**∴ An additional discount of 11% must be given to bring the net selling price to ₹10947.**

questions.question: A cylindrical pillar is 85 cm in diameter and 7 m in height. The cost of painting the curved surface of the pillar at the rate of ₹20 per m² is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A cylindrical pillar is 85 cm in diameter and 7 m in height.

**Concept used:**

Curved surface area of cylinder = 2πrh

Where, r = radius, h = height

**Calculation:**

Curved surface area of the cylindrical pillar

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × (85/200) × 7 [1 m = 100 cm]

⇒ 18.7 m²

Required cost = 18.7 × 20 = ₹374

**∴ The cost of painting the curved surface of the pillar at the rate of ₹20 per m2 is ₹374.**

questions.question: One side of a right-angled triangle is thrice the other and the hypotenuse is 8 cm. Find the area of the triangle.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

One side of a right-angled triangle is thrice the other.

The hypotenuse is 8 cm

**Concept used:**

Area of a right angle triangle = (1/2) × p × b

Where, p = perpendicular, b = base

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92fe47107568c3e74b7fef54e486f5830d6ac4deae1cb21ce1736b4488ef1af3.png] 

Let the sides be 3x cm and x cm

⇒ 3x² + x² = 8²

⇒ 9x2 + x2 = 64

⇒ 10x2 = 64

⇒ x2 = 64/10

Area of the triangle = (1/2) × 3x × x

⇒ (1/2) × 3x²

⇒ (1/2) × 3 × 64/10

⇒ 96/10 = 9.6 cm²

**∴ The area of the triangle is 9.6 cm2.**

questions.question: Three candidates, A, B and C contested an election and received 1800, 3300 and 3900 votes, respectively. What percentage of the total votes did B get (correct to two decimal places), assuming no vote was invalid?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A, B, and C contested an election and received 1800, 3300, and 3900 votes respectively

**Calculation:**

Total votes = 1800 + 3300 + 3900 = 9000

Required % = (3300/9000) × 100

⇒ 36.66 ≈ 36.67%

**∴ B got 36.67% of the total votes.**

questions.question: John can complete a piece of work in 6 days working 8 hours each day and Manu can complete it in 3 days working 4 hours each day. How long will they take to complete it, working together 9(3)/(5) hours a day?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

John can complete the work in 6 days working 8 hours each day

Manu can complete the work in 3 days working 4 hours each day

**Concept used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Let the efficiency of John be x units/hour

⇒ Total work = 6 × 8x = 48x

Efficiency of Manu = 48x/(3 × 4) = 4x

Effective efficiency = x + 4x = 5x

Time = ( (48x)/(frac{48){5}×5x}) = (48x)/(48x) = 1 day

**∴ The required time is 1 day.**

questions.question: The greatest number that divides 415, 688 and 825 leaving 7, 8 and 9 as remainders, respectively is:
questions.solution:

Numbers = 415, 688, 825

Remainders = 7, 8 and 9

**Concept used:**

Required Number = HCF of the divisible numbers

**Calculation:**

Numbers which are fully divisible

⇒ 415 - 7 = 408

⇒ 668 - 8 = 680

⇒ 825 - 9 = 816

Calculating HCF

408 = 2³ × 3 × 17

680 = 2³ × 5 × 17

816 = 2⁴ × 3 × 17

⇒ HCF = 2³ × 17 = 8 × 17 = 136

**∴ The required answer is 136.**

questions.question: In how much time will ₹5,000 amount to ₹6,800 at a simple interest of 9% per annum?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sum = Rs. 5000

Rate = 9%

**Concept used:**

S.I = (P × T × R)/100

S.I = Amount - P

Here, P = Sum, T = Time, R = Rate 

**Calculation:**

S.I = 6800 - 5000 = 1800

Let the time be T

According to the question,

1800 = (5000 × T × 9)/100

⇒ 450T = 1800

⇒ T = 1800/450 = 4

**∴ The required time is 4 years.**

questions.question: A sold an article to B at 25% profit, who sold it to C at 20% profit. C sold to D at 45 % loss. If D bought it for ₹330 then B bought the article (in ₹) for:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Applying successive formula

A × (125)/(100) × (120)/(100) × (55)/(100) = 330

⇒ A = 400

⇒ CP for B = 400 × (125)/(100) = ₹500

∴ B bought the article for ₹500.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A sold an article to B at 25% profit

B sold it to C at 20% profit

C sold is to D at 45 % loss

**Concept used:**

**1**. SP = CP × (100 + Profit)%

**2**. SP = CP × (100 - Loss)%

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price of the article to A be 100x

SP of A = 100x × (100 + 25)%

⇒ 100x × 125% = 125x

CP of B = 125x

⇒ SP of B = 125x × (100 + 20)% = 150x

CP of C = 150x

SP of C = 150x × (100 - 45)% = 82.5x

CP of D = 82.5x

⇒ 82.5x = 330

⇒ x = 330/82.5 = 4

CP of B = 125 × 4 = 500

**∴ B bought the article for ₹****500.**

questions.question: The average of five numbers a, b , c, d and e is 150. If the average of the first three numbers a, b and c is 130, then the average of the last two numbers d and e is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average of five numbers a, b , c, d and e is 150

The average of the first three numbers a, b and c is 130

**Concept used:**

Average = Sum of elements/Number of elements

**Calculation:**

Total of a + b + c + d = 150 × 5 = 750

Total of a + b + c = 130 × 3 = 390

⇒ Total of d + e = 750 - 390 = 360

⇒ Average of d and e = 360/2 = 180

**∴ The average of the last two numbers d and e is 180.**

questions.question: If the cost price is 84% of the selling price, then what is the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The cost price is 84% of the selling price

**Concept used:**

Profit % = (Profit/CP) × 100

**Calculation:**

CP = (84/100) × SP

⇒ 100 CP = 84 SP

⇒ CP/SP = 84/100 = 21/25

Ratio of CP : SP = 21 : 25

⇒ Profit = 25 - 21 = 4

⇒ Profit% = (4/21) × 100 = 19(1)/({21)} \%

**∴ The profit percentage is 19(1)/({21)} \%.**

questions.question: The average age of five person is 28 yrs. If one of them is excluded the average decreases by 2 yrs. The age of the excluded person in yrs is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

After excluding a person the average age decreases by 2

A = Old Avg + (Decrease in Avg) × New no. of terms

Where, A = Age of excluded person

⇒ A = 28 + (2) × 4 = 28 + 8 = 36 years

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of age of five person = 28

Average age after exclusion of 1 person = 26 

**Formula used:**

Average =(Sum of values)/(Total number of values)

**Calculation:**

Sum of age of five person = 28 × 5 = 140 

Sum of age of four numbers = 26 × 4 = 104 

Age of excluded person = 140 – 104 = 36 

**∴ The age of the excluded person is 36 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

After excluding a value, if the average increases

Excluded = Old Avg + (Increase in Avg) × New no. of terms

questions.question: A box contains 25p and 10p in the ratio 6 : 5, amounting to ₹226. Find the number of 10p coins.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A box contains 25p and 10p in the ratio 6 : 5

Total amount = ₹226

**Calculation:**

Let the number of 25p and 10p coins be 6x and 5x

⇒ 25 × 6x + 10 × 5x = 226 × 100 [As ₹1 = 100p]

⇒ 150x + 50x = 22600

⇒ 200x = 22600

⇒ x = 113

Number of 10p coins = 113 × 5 = 565

**∴ The number of 10p coins is 565.**

questions.question: The ratio of four positive numbers is 5 : 8 : 12 : 18 and their LCM is 2880.The difference between the greater and the small number is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of four positive numbers is 5 : 8 : 12 : 18

LCM of the numbers is 2880

**Calculation:**

Let the numbers be 5x, 8x, 12x and 18x

LCM of 5x, 8x, 12x and 18x = 360x

According to the question,

360x = 2880

⇒ x = 2880/360 = 8

Difference between the greatest and the smallest number

⇒ (18 × 8) - (5 × 8)

⇒ 8 (18 - 5) = 104

**∴ The difference between the greater and the small number is 104.**
